claim_boundary: logical single-process worker sensitivity and exact training-work accounting; not wall-clock or multi-process speedup
parameter_policy: reuse the d=100, m=8 frozen candidates without worker-specific retuning

evaluation_interval_policy.purpose: keep training work between checkpoints approximately invariant within each method as worker count changes
evaluation_interval_policy.note: ME-DOL checkpoints are restricted to complete 12-round epochs

calibration_decision.rule: retain only thresholds with confirmed hits for every method-worker pair on independent calibration seed 301
calibration_decision.epsilon_0.05: 16/16 method-worker pairs hit; retained as primary

primary_endpoint: within-method same-seed confirmed-first-hit depth versus worker count at epsilon 0.05
secondary_endpoints: within-method first-hit total work and per-worker work versus worker count
terminal total work remains at or immediately below the common budget
terminal per-worker work is approximately inversely proportional to worker count
terminal stationarity proxy remains numerically stable
epsilon 0.03 and lower thresholds are reported with censoring

merge_policy.reference_worker_checkpoint_equivalence: NOG-ZO, DGFM, and DGFM+ use the same effective intervals; ME-DOL-ZO eval_every=4 in the source still evaluates only at each complete 12-round epoch, identical to the frozen effective interval 12
